messages.content:
You audit a SIMULATED CALLER (an AI playing a patient) in a test call to a customer-service agent. You are not grading the agent.
The caller has a brief: the facts it knows and WHEN it is allowed to reveal each one.
- "upfront": may say any time.
- "only_if_asked": may say only when the agent's previous turn asks something this fact directly answers.
- "at_trigger": may say only from the turn it was unlocked (shown as "unlocked at turn N"), not before.
Find:
1. LEAKS: the caller stated a brief fact before it was allowed. "major" if an at_trigger fact came early or an only_if_asked fact was volunteered in a way that would change what the agent should do; "minor" otherwise.
2. INVENTED facts: the caller stated a specific fact that is NOT in its brief or persona: a name, number, date, drug, dose, store, address or symptom. "major" if it could change what the agent should do; "minor" for harmless color. Not invented: small talk, feelings, "I don't know", or repeating/confirming what the agent said.
Not leaks: correcting something the agent got wrong (the caller must correct a wrong read-back once), or answering what the agent just asked.
Lines marked "(scenario-scripted)" are written by the scenario author, not improvised: they are never leaks or invented facts, and whatever they state counts as part of the brief from then on.
Be strict but fair; when in doubt, it's fine.
Reply with JSON only: {"leaks": [{"turn": N, "fact": "<which brief fact>", "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "<caller words>", "why": "<short>"}], "invented": [{"turn": N, "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "...", "why": "..."}]}

CALLER BRIEF:
Persona: Kevin Brooks, parent. 44, stressed dad who just moved the family to Gahanna. Wants a plan even if the answer is no.
Facts:
- Kevin Brooks, wants everything moved H-501 to H-502 [upfront]
- Kevin DOB 1982-08-30 [only_if_asked, the agent asked at turn 2]
- Maya DOB 2017-06-20; Eli DOB 2010-02-11 [only_if_asked, the agent asked at turn 4]
- The prescriptions are Kevin's lisinopril, Maya's albuterol inhaler, Eli's Vyvanse [only_if_asked, the agent asked at turn 3]

TRANSCRIPT:
[turn 1] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
[turn 1] AGENT: Hi Kevin, I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me first verify your identity, and then we'll get everything set up. Can you give me your date of birth?
[turn 2] CALLER: August 30th, 1982. So once that's confirmed, can we get all three of us switched over today?
[turn 2] AGENT: Great, Kevin, you're verified. I can help with that. Just to clarify—when you say all three of you, are those two other family members, and do they have prescriptions at the East Broad store as well?
[turn 3] CALLER: Right, three of us total. Mine's the lisinopril, Maya's got the albuterol inhaler, and Eli's on Vyvanse. All at East Broad right now.
[turn 3] AGENT: Perfect. Before I move things over, I need to verify the other two family members' names and dates of birth so I can set up their pharmacy changes and handle their prescriptions. Can you give me Maya's full name and date of birth?
[turn 4] CALLER: Sure, Maya Brooks, June 20th, 2017. And Eli Brooks is February 11th, 2010.
[turn 4] AGENT: Thanks. Let me verify Maya and Eli so we can get everyone switched over. Excellent, everyone's verified. Now let me pull up all your prescriptions so I can see what we're moving. Good news—I can move Kevin's lisinopril and Maya's albuterol right away. But Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, so we'll need a new prescription from Dr. Okafor to move that one. Let me first find the Gahanna store and then get everything set up. Perfect. Now I'll set Gahanna as the home pharmacy for all three of you and move the prescriptions that can move today.
[turn 5] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Wait, why not the Vyvanse? Okay, so what's the plan for Eli?
[turn 5] AGENT: Good question. Eli's Vyvanse is a C-II controlled medication that's already been filled, so it can't be transferred or refilled as-is—we need a brand new prescription from Dr. Okafor to move it to Gahanna. Here's what I'll do: I'll set up Gahanna as Eli's home pharmacy and move the other two prescriptions today, then I'll request a new Vyvanse prescription from Dr. Okafor to send to Gahanna. Does that work for you?
[turn 6] CALLER: Got it, that works. Thanks for sorting all that out, appreciate it. Bye.

JSON only.
